dataPolicy.subtitle: How data on this platform is sourced, verified and updated.
dataPolicy.modelInfo: Model information (name, context window, release date) is compiled from official provider documentation and maintained manually.
dataPolicy.pricing: Pricing data is sourced from official provider pricing pages; historic prices are recorded in the price history.
dataPolicy.benchmark: Benchmark scores are currently demo/manual data (dataset: internal-demo) and clearly marked as unverified until replaced by official benchmark results.
dataPolicy.ranking: Ranking is computed transparently from benchmark, capabilities, price and context (see methodology on the ranking page).
dataPolicy.verified: verified — manually checked against the official source.
dataPolicy.unverified: unverified — not yet manually checked; treat with caution.
dataPolicy.updatePricing: Pricing & models: manual / API, on change.
dataPolicy.transparencyText: We are committed to transparent data. Every figure you see can be traced to its source and status. Demo data is never presented as verified. This project is free, open and non-commercial.

home.subtitle: Explore 40+ models from 14 providers — compare pricing, count tokens, estimate costs, check rankings, and follow AI news. No account, no ads, no paywall.

home.featureTokensDesc: Count tokens with an accurate tokenizer, measure characters, and see how different models price the same text.

home.featureRankingDesc: Transparent scoring across benchmark, capability, price, and context — updated daily with trend history.
home.featureNewsDesc: Daily aggregated AI industry news from major labs, with RSS feed and multi-language pages.
home.transparencyDesc: Every price carries its source and verification status. Data comes from official pricing pages where possible, and unknown values are clearly marked — no ads, no affiliate links, no paywall, ever.
